北京.name: 北京
北京.ai_briefing_zh: 北京朋友，体感 -4℃，添衣保暖，别着凉哦！
北京.ai_briefing_en: Beijing friends, it feels like -4℃, dress warmly to avoid catching a cold!

慈溪.ai_briefing_zh: 慈溪阴天，体感 1℃，风力 3级，多穿点，注意防风。
慈溪.ai_briefing_en: Cixi is cloudy, feels like 1℃ with moderate wind, wear more and mind the wind.

上海.ai_briefing_zh: 上海有雾，体感 3℃，注意交通安全和呼吸道健康。
上海.ai_briefing_en: Shanghai is foggy, feels like 3℃, mind traffic safety and respiratory health.

广州.name: 广州
广州.ai_briefing_zh: 广州大风，体感 4℃！风大记得添衣，注意防风。

深圳.name: 深圳
深圳.ai_briefing_zh: 深圳晴朗，体感 15℃。天气舒适，出门 Enjoy 哦！
深圳.ai_briefing_en: Shenzhen is sunny, feels like 15℃. Enjoy the comfortable weather!

杭州.name: 杭州
杭州.ai_briefing_zh: 杭州阴天，体感 3℃，有些湿冷，注意保暖别感冒。
杭州.ai_briefing_en: Hangzhou is cloudy, feels like 3℃, a bit damp and cold, stay warm and avoid colds.

南京.name: 南京
南京.ai_briefing_zh: 南京有霾，体感 3℃。出门记得戴口罩，保护呼吸道。
南京.ai_briefing_en: Nanjing has haze, feels like 3℃. Wear a mask when going out to protect your lungs.

成都.name: 成都
成都.ai_briefing_zh: 成都阴天，体感 4℃。出门别忘了带伞，注意保暖。
成都.ai_briefing_en: Chengdu is cloudy, feels like 4℃. Don't forget your umbrella, and stay warm.

武汉.name: 武汉
武汉.ai_briefing_zh: 武汉大雾，体感 1℃。能见度低，驾车出行要小心！

西安.name: 西安
西安.ai_briefing_zh: 西安多云，体感 -1℃。注意添衣，别让寒气入体。
西安.ai_briefing_en: Xi'an is cloudy, feels like -1℃. Add layers, don't let the cold get to you.

重庆.name: 重庆
重庆.ai_briefing_zh: 重庆阴天，体感 7℃。出门注意添衣，保持好心情。

哈尔滨.name: 哈尔滨
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_zh: 哈尔滨体感 -19℃！请务必多穿，防寒保暖第一位。
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_en: Harbin feels like -19℃! Please dress very warmly, stay safe from the cold.

沈阳.name: 沈阳
沈阳.ai_briefing_zh: 沈阳体感 -16℃。寒冷依旧，小心别冻着了！

大连.name: 大连

大连.ai_briefing_en: Dalian is cloudy, feels like -3℃. No wind, but still stay warm!
